title: Ich mag dich
desc: Three words with months between them
setting: A train along the lake, a story about somebody on her ward, and the wrong moment.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.es: Ich sitze jeden Abend zehn Minuten bei ihr.
steps.en: I sit with her for ten minutes every evening.

options.feedback: Ask. She is telling you something about herself and calling it a story about somebody else.
It is, and saying so turns her into somebody being praised. She will change the subject.
Not wrong, and not now. She is in the middle of something. Wait for the end of it.
Now. Ich mag dich is the small warm one and it is not small at all when it is said to a person.
Months too early. Here that word is an event, not a goodbye, and using it now spends it.
The step above. It sounds smaller in English and it is bigger in German.
Four seconds. Filling them would be the mistake: she is deciding what to do with what you said.
Now she has to manage your worry instead of her own answer. Let the silence finish.

options.en: You do not have to say anything.
options.feedback: Kind, and it takes the answer away from her. She was going to give you one.
She will go back to her story. Going back to the story is the biggest thing she can do: nothing is broken.
Yes. Asking makes her say it twice, and here nobody says anything twice.
Small and safe. It also closes something she just opened at some cost.
